questions.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $105 in October?
questions.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation and during a trading session of October 2026, any Pyth 1-minute candle for the Active Month of ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures (denoted by Pyth as "CLL") has a final "High" or "Low" price equal to or beyond (above for ↑ High Prices, below for ↓ Low Prices) the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

Only prices achieved during an applicable trading session of the specified timeframe's business days will be considered (See: "Trading Hours" at https://www.ice.com/products/213/WTI-Crude-Futures). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 8:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date, except for the session dated Monday, which begins at 6:00 PM ET on the preceding Sunday, and where modified by holiday or other special hours (See: https://www.ice.com/holiday-hours).

The Active Month is the nearest listed contract, except during that contract's final three trading sessions. At the open of the third-to-last trading session, the next listed contract becomes the Active Month.

Each contract's last trading day will be determined by ICE Futures Europe per the WTI Crude Futures contract specification (generally the 4th US business day prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract month, or five US business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a US business day). The last trading day for each contract is posted at https://www.ice.com/products/213/WTI-Crude-Futures/expiry.

For example, if the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Monday the 20th, the next listed contract would become the Active Month at the start of the trading session for Thursday the 16th (8:00 PM ET on Wednesday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high/low price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil Futures contract by ICE Futures Europe may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session (See: https://www.ice.com/report/10 with "T-West Texas Intermediate Light Sweet Crude Future" selected).

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures Active Month "High" and "Low" prices available at https://app.pyth.com/explore?search=CLL, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

questions.question: Will Anthropic have the best Code Arena | WebDev AI at the end of October 2026?

If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., “Google” would be ranked ahead of “SpaceXAI”). The resolution source for this market is the arena.ai Code Arena | WebDev Leaderboard. If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve to "Other".

forecasts.rationale: ISW's 13 October assessment described Russian infiltration into western Svitle and Ukrainian strikes on those servicemembers, and its 16 October assessment found no evidence of a Russian advance into Dobropillya beyond limited infiltration. DeepState's 17 October update kept Svitle in the infiltration (grey) zone even as Russia gained 7.22 square kilometres nearby, and ISW's 19 October report described a Ukrainian advance east of Dobropillya. Infiltration shading does not qualify under the rule, so Yes needs ISW to move the intersection into assessed Russian-controlled terrain or assessed advances and hold it for a full update cycle within 11 days, which the current trend does not favour.

questions.question: Will Russia capture Svitle by October 31?
questions.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the intersection at 48.405560° N, 37.119791° E in Svitle, Donetsk Oblast, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET.

The intersection will be considered captured if any part of the intersection is shaded under a below specified layer on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. Otherwise, the market will resolve to “No”.

For any change on the ISW map to qualify for this market’s resolution, the relevant shading must persist through the next full ISW daily update cycle. If ISW skips a day, shading must persist until the next finalized ISW update is published, regardless of the date.

Any continuous shading under the following layers will qualify:
- Assessed Russian-Controlled Terrain
- Assessed Russian Advances

Shading under the following layers will not qualify:
- Assessed Russian Infiltration Areas
- Claimed Russian Territory

Once a qualifying condition is met, any subsequent loss of control will not be considered towards the resolution of this market.

If Russia comes into control of the specified territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of whether it is shaded under a qualifying layer on the ISW map. However, an announcement of a negotiated settlement that gives Russia de jure control will not qualify. Actual control must be established.

Intersection Location in Svitle: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Svitle1.png

Svitle Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Svitle2.png

Location on Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/h4wD9Vc9XvfYZ3417

The primary resolution source for this market will be the ISW Ukraine map. If the ISW map is rendered unavailable, information from DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used. If information from both the ISW and DeepStateMap are rendered permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

Note: Any temporary glitches or errors in the map will not be considered.

questions.question: Will commitments to the 1W public sale exceed $60M?
questions.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if total commitments to the official 1W public sale exceed the specified value at any point before November 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is the headline pool total displayed on the official 1W Token Sale page at https://1wtoken.com/ (the "US$[amount] of US$[allocation]" figure). Total commitments refers to this gross pool amount, including any oversubscription above the sale's allocation, and not the final allocated amount after excess deposits are refunded. If the sale page displays only a net or allocated figure rather than the gross pool amount, official announcements of the gross amount from 1W will be used. The sale accepts deposits in US dollar stablecoins (USDC), which are counted as US dollars at 1:1.

If the displayed figure exceeds the specified value at any point before November 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Yes" regardless of subsequent refunds or cancellations. A displayed figure exactly equal to the specified value will not qualify. If the figure on the sale page is unavailable, official announcements from 1W (https://x.com/1winToken) may be used; if no official figure is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used. If no commitment total is verifiable by November 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, including because the sale is put on hold, cancelled, or rescheduled to a time past that date, this market will resolve to "No". If requisite information for this market's resolution becomes permanently unavailable within this market's timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

If the sale is extended before the official closing time, commitments made during the extended period will count toward resolution, provided the displayed figure exceeds the specified value before November 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

forecasts.rationale: Proposition 40, the one-time tax of up to 5% on billionaires, qualified for the 3 November 2026 ballot (California Secretary of State, 17 June), so the ballot-qualification condition is met. A Citrin-POLITICO poll published 19 October put likely voters at 46% yes and 43% no, short of a majority and unchanged from a month earlier. Ballotpedia's 1910 to 2025 record has ballot initiatives approved 36% of the time, and undecided voters usually break toward No late. Competing Propositions 41 and 42 could nullify Proposition 40 even with a majority, per the Legislative Analyst's Office, which lowers the chance further.

forecasts.rationale: The Clerk of the House list of 1 October 2026 shows 218 Republicans, 214 Democrats, 1 independent and 2 vacancies, so Republicans are at the 218 line and can lose at most two seats net (Ballotpedia). Against that, an ABC News/Washington Post/Ipsos poll of 9 to 13 October, published 18 October, has likely voters preferring Democrats 52% to 44% with Trump approval at 33%, and Cook's Erin Covey projected on 19 October a Democratic net gain of 10 to 20 seats. In 18 of 20 postwar midterms the president's party lost House seats. Mid-decade redistricting in several states helps Republicans, but a Republican majority needs them to beat this environment.

questions.question: Republicans have a House majority after 2026 midterms?
questions.resolution_criteria:
Resolution criteria

This market will resolve to "Yes" if, following the 2026 United States House of Representatives elections, the Republican Party holds at least 218 seats, thereby securing a majority in the House. Conversely, it will resolve to "No" if the Republicans hold fewer than 218 seats. The official election results, as reported by the Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives, will serve as the primary source for resolution. (ballotpedia.org)

Background

The 2026 midterm elections, scheduled for November 3, 2026, will determine the composition of the 120th United States Congress. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives will be contested. As of June 2025, the Republican Party holds a narrow majority with 220 seats, while the Democratic Party holds 213 seats. (ballotpedia.org)

questions.question: Will Meta's Muse still be the #1 free iPhone app in the US on October 31, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
Resolves YES if Muse from Meta is ranked #1 on Apple's US App Store Top Free iPhone Apps chart on October 31, 2026.

How it's checked: Apple's official public chart feed, https://rss.marketingtools.apple.com/api/v2/us/apps/top-free/10/apps.json. The first snapshot whose updated timestamp is at or after 17:00 UTC on October 31, 2026 decides it. If the feed is unavailable, the App Store app's Top Charts → Free (US, iPhone) seen on that date decides it, confirmed by a public screenshot or a chart tracker (e.g. appfigures, Sensor Tower).

Details:

Only the overall Top Free iPhone chart counts. Category charts (Productivity, etc.), Top Paid, and iPad charts don't count.

If Meta renames the app but it is the same App Store listing, it still counts.

If Muse is #2 or lower, or was removed from the store, this resolves NO.

Trading closes at 16:00 UTC on Oct 31, before the check.

Context: Muse has been the #1 free iPhone app in the US every day since Sept 18, 2026, and was still #1 at 13:34 UTC on Sept 28 (Momo AI #2, ChatGPT #3). Launch-driven #1s usually fade within a few weeks, but Meta is promoting Muse heavily. Companion market: Will Muse rank #1 in App Store on October 1st.
